name: ludora
description: Ludora: an educational gaming platform. Quiz-powered multiplayer games, collectible Glims, shops and classroom tools.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ludora/web && npm run build -w @ludora/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/engine && tsc -p packages/content && tsc -p server && tsc -p web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
